newsitem.title: USA: Prudential starts emerging growth fund.
newsitem.headline: Prudential starts emerging growth fund.

text.p: Prudential Investments said it launched the Prudential Emerging Growth Fund.
The U.S. growth stock fund, managed by Susan Hirsch, will invest in small and medium-sized companies with market capitalizations ranging from $500 million to $4.5 billion.
Before joining Prudential this year, Hirsch was with Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc's Global Asset Management unit.
Prudential, a unit of Prudential Insurance Co of America, has more than $175 billion in assets under management.
